slug: 2024-12-24 Morocco's DGSN issued 4.6 million electronic national IDs in 2024 (annual report)

MAR.note: Only cards issued in 2024 are counted, not people enrolled over the population.
Nothing on a number at birth.

facts.fact: The DGSN, Morocco's national security directorate, issued nearly 4.7 million electronic national ID cards in 2024 at its Rabat and Marrakech centres and ran the second phase of the electronic identity system, per its annual report.

MAR.note: Authorised institutions use a verification platform, but no public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The DGSN issued nearly 4.7 million electronic national identity cards in 2024 (3.4 million Rabat, 1.2 million Marrakech), per its annual report.
